extensionDescription.message: Download videos as MP4 and animations as GIF directly from your X feed.

downloadStarted.message: Download started. You can find the file in browser downloads.

extensionRestarted.message: The extension restarted. Reload the X page.

reloadPage.message: Reload the X page and try again.

downloadInterrupted.message: Download interrupted. Check browser downloads and try again.

linkMissing.message: Video link not found yet. Open the post, reload the page, and try again.

downloadFailed.message: The browser could not start the download. Reload the post and try again.

gifBusy.message: Another GIF is being created. Please wait and try again.

gifFailed.message: Could not create the GIF. Reload the post and try again. No MP4 was saved.

gifTooLarge.message: GIF conversion limits exceeded: 120 seconds, 2,073,600 output pixels, 50 MiB source or 128 MiB GIF. Try a lower resolution, frame rate or color count in settings.

settingsSubtitle.message: Tune GIF size and quality for your next download.

scaleHelp.message: Percentage of the original width and height. 50% means one quarter of the pixels.

scaleExample.message: Example: 1280 × 720 → $WIDTH$ × $HEIGHT$ · $PIXELS$% of the pixels. File size depends on the content.

fpsHelp.message: Fewer frames make a smaller file. More frames keep motion smoother.

colorsHelp.message: A smaller palette can reduce file size but may show color banding.

gifOnlyNote.message: These settings apply to GIFs. Videos keep their original MP4 quality.

locationHelp.message: Applies to both videos and GIFs.

settingsFooter.message: Settings stay in this browser profile.

settingsSaved.message: Saved. The next download will use these settings.

settingsResetPending.message: Defaults restored in the form. Click Save settings to apply.

settingsLoadFailed.message: Could not read saved settings. Please try again.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Your changes have not been applied.

downloadCancelled.message: Download cancelled because the tab or extension was closed.

settingsIntro.message: Choose the quality, give files a useful name, and keep saving from your feed.

videoQualityIntro.message: Pick what matters most. Videos are saved as MP4.

videoQualityHelp.message: Uses an MP4 offered by X, without re-encoding. If your chosen size is unavailable, the closest lower size is used; if all are larger, the smallest is used. Unknown sizes use the best available variant.

videoSoundNote.message: The selected MP4 is saved with its existing sound, duration and frame rate.

gifQualityTitle.message: A lighter GIF, in one click.

gifQualityIntro.message: Start with a preset, then fine-tune if you want.

filesTitle.message: Recognize your files at a glance.

filesIntro.message: Use a ready-made name or create your own with tags.

nameHelp.message: The extension adds .mp4 or .gif for you. Click a tag to insert it into the selected field.

filenameSafety.message: Unsupported filename characters are replaced automatically. Existing files are never overwritten.

tagMissingNote.message: Missing author, date or resolution becomes “unknown”. Missing text uses the post ID. Dates use UTC. For reposts and quotes, tags describe the source post containing the media.

folderHelp.message: One folder inside your default download folder. Leave blank to save directly there. The save dialog can override this.

applyNext.message: Changes apply to the next download.

nameTemplateInvalid.message: Enter a filename template, up to 180 characters.

nameTagInvalid.message: Unknown or incomplete tag. Use the tags shown below.

tagIndex.message: Media number in the post, starting at 1
